overview.description: The NYLIM International Small-Mid Cap Equity ETF (NISM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of foreign small- and mid-cap stocks selected based on macroeconomic analysis and fundamental research of individual companies. The ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation.n NISM was launched on May 13, 2026 and is issued by NYLIM.
